Your first visit

Your first visit,
step by step.

From your first question to a dental care plan you understand. Here's what to expect.

  1. 01

    Start with a conversation.

    Tell us what brings you in and request a time that works for you. The clinic will contact you to confirm availability.

  2. 02

    Understand your options.

    Discuss your goals and assessment with the dental team. Ask about the proposed treatment, timing and costs.

  3. 03

    Plan your next step.

    Make time for your questions and talk through the plan with the team before deciding how you'd like to proceed.

A few helpful answers

Before we
say hello.

Practical details to help you feel a little more prepared.

Explore all our FAQs
Can I ask questions before booking?

Yes. You can call the team or use the appointment form to share what you'd like to discuss. Mention any concerns and the service you're interested in when you get in touch.

What can I ask about at my first visit?

Bring your questions about your teeth, previous dental care or treatment options. Ask the team to explain what the visit involves and any information they would like you to bring.

How do I request an appointment?

The appointment form shows the details normally needed to plan a visit, including your preferred service and time. This is a design preview; the form does not send requests or book appointments.
